$comment: Machine-checkable incremental cost model for the OPTIONAL E4 operations CONTROL PLANE (GitHub issue #416). This file is the single source of truth for the E4 incremental cost numbers in docs/operations-e4-cost-notes.md. backend/tests/unit/test_operations_e4_cost_model_unit.py recomputes every scenario total from the formulas below and asserts the published totals here match, so documentation cannot drift from the pricing inputs. It does NOT assert any E4 infrastructure is deployed. E4 reuses the 06 DynamoDB table and CMK for audit records, so it adds NO incremental storage or KMS-key charge; the 06 cost model already accounts for those. All account ids/regions here are public-safe.

design.control_shape: AWS AppConfig kill-switch (application/environment/hosted profile/strategies) + control Lambda behind an HTTP API + EventBridge freshness sweeper
design.notes: E4 introduces AWS AppConfig for a deployment-wide kill-switch document. AppConfig is billed per configuration retrieved (data-plane GetLatestConfiguration) and there is no charge for the application/environment/profile/strategy resources themselves. The AppConfig Lambda extension caches the document in-process, so consumers poll AppConfig on a bounded cadence rather than per request. The control Lambda and EventBridge sweeper are request/schedule-scoped and scale to zero when idle. No data store or KMS key is created by E4.

default_unprovisioned.$comment: Provisioned=false: ZERO resources, $0. This is the default.

enabled_idle.$comment: Provisioned=true, ControlMode=enabled, but no admin control actions taken. Steady-state cost is the CloudWatch custom metrics the control plane can emit plus the seven E4 alarms, plus the AppConfig config retrievals driven by the extension cache-refresh cadence across the E1/E2/E3 consumers and the freshness sweeper. No API requests, no control Lambda invocations beyond the sweeper.

per_control_action.$comment: One admin control action: one control API request, one control Lambda invocation, one AppConfig hosted version + one deployment (the deployment itself is not separately metered; only config retrievals are). Cost is dominated by fixed idle; a single action is fractions of a cent.

representative_load.$comment: A busy month of manual control actions.
